# Where this product puts its files, and what `flz reset` does with each
# subtree. One row per subtree, `<name>|<reset mode>`, read by both runtimes:
# `Flezha.Layout.Table` declares the controller's side and
# `cli/src/reset/plan.rs`'s `CLEARABLE_ROOTS` the shell's, and a test on each
# side reads this file. Before, the two spelled the list separately and an
# operator could not tell which one was right.
#
# `default` is cleared on every reset, `flag` only when the operator asks for
# it by name, and `never` is not reset's to clear — clearing `auth` would
# destroy an operator's tokens. A `never` row must be ABSENT from the Rust
# table, which is what makes this file a check rather than a copy.
#
# Order is the order reset reports.
state|default
process_hub|default
certs|flag
sockets|flag
auth|never
audit|never
dlq|never
plugins|never
schedules|never
logs|never
